source.text: A case with one fault: assumptions.thermalOnly false (mechanics asked for) with no mechanics section: nothing says the stress-free temperature, the axial condition, the contact or the coolant pressure. FEED must refuse it before any run; SEED reports E_PROP_MISSING.
source.check: FEED's schema vectors (schema/vectors/bad/mechanics-section-missing.json) assert the same code in FEED's own test suite.
